# Capability Boundaries

This document defines what the js-reverse-automation skill can, partially can, and cannot do using chrome-devtools-mcp + JSRPC.

## Can Do (Stable)

| Capability | Implementation |
|---|---|
| Open/refresh/wait pages | `navigate_page`, `wait_for` |
| Read page DOM/snapshots | `take_snapshot`, `take_screenshot` |
| Read console messages | `list_console_messages` |
| Read network request list and details | `list_network_requests`, `get_network_request` |
| Execute JS in page context | `evaluate_script` |
| Pre-inject JS before page load | `navigate_page(initScript=...)` |
| Read in-page objects and serialization | `evaluate_script` returning JSON |
| Capture call stacks via `Error().stack` | `evaluate_script` |
| Hook fetch/XHR/FormData/JSON.stringify/crypto.subtle | `evaluate_script` (soft hook) |
| Hook WebSocket send/receive | `evaluate_script` |
| Call global functions by path | `evaluate_script` + `getByPath(window, path)` |
| Call Webpack exports (if `__webpack_require__` captured) | `evaluate_script` + module probe |
| Handle sync functions | JSRPC action handler |
| Handle async/Promise functions | JSRPC action handler with `.then()` |
| Generate JSRPC/Flask/Burp artifacts | `emit_*.py` scripts |
| Validate artifacts | `validate_artifacts.py` |

## Partially Can Do (Limited)

| Capability | Limitation |
|---|---|
| Webpack module export discovery | Only if chunk array is accessible and `__webpack_require__` can be captured |
| Closure-scoped function access | Only if the function is exported through module system or flows through hook points |
| Dynamic import resolution | Can observe the request but cannot reliably capture the imported module's exports |
| Anti-debug bypass | Can patch simple checks; complex obfuscated anti-debug may require manual intervention |
| HTTP/2 multiplexed request attribution | Can read requests but cannot distinguish stream-level attribution |
| Multi-layer encryption | Can trace each layer if they flow through hook points; deeply nested closures may be opaque |
| Service Worker page-level observation | Can observe SW registration but cannot inspect SW internal state |

## Cannot Do (Explicitly Unsupported)

| Capability | Reason |
|---|---|
| Real JS debugger breakpoint with paused call frame | chrome-devtools-mcp lacks `Debugger.setBreakpoint` / `Debugger.resume` / `callFrames` |
| Read closure-scoped variables | No scope chain access; can only observe what flows through window/exports/hooks |
| Call unexported WASM internal functions | WASM internals are not accessible from JS context |
| Access Service Worker internal closures | SW runs in separate thread; page JS cannot access SW scope |
| Intercept native ES module `import` resolution | ES modules use browser-native loading; no hook point for resolution |
| Reverse VMP/obfuscated virtual machines | Static analysis of runtime-generated bytecode is out of scope |
| Read TLS fingerprint / JA3 | Network-level details not exposed to page JS |
| Persistent hook state across page navigations | Hooks must be re-injected via `initScript` on each navigation |
| Hook `WebSocket` binary frames | Only text JSON payloads supported by Hlclient |
| VM-protected JS (pceptor.js type) | JS VM protection causes `evaluate_script` timeout; cannot inject hook or extract encryption function |
| CSP WebSocket bypass | CSP `connect-src` blocks `ws://localhost`; page JS cannot bypass browser network-layer restriction |
| Cross-origin iframe internal functions | Same-origin policy prevents accessing functions inside cross-origin iframes |
| initScript bypassing VMP | `initScript` runs before page JS but cannot prevent VM-protected code from executing |

## Confidence Levels

| Level | Meaning | Evidence Required |
|---|---|---|
| `high` | Entrypoint is confirmed and callable | Network evidence (request body) + Runtime evidence (hook/stack/module) |
| `medium` | Entrypoint is likely but needs verification | Single evidence source (either network or runtime) |
| `low` | Only heuristic matches found | Keyword search or source code pattern only |

## Strategy Values

| Strategy | Meaning | Action |
|---|---|---|
| `global_path` | Function found on `window` via dotted path | Generate JSRPC action |
| `runtime_hook` | Function identified via soft hook call stack | Generate JSRPC action |
| `webpack_export` | Function found in Webpack module cache | Generate JSRPC action (requires captured require) |
| `async_crypto` | Function is async (crypto.subtle or Promise-based) | Generate JSRPC action with async handler |
| `wasm_export` | Function is exported from WASM module | Generate JSRPC action |
| `manual_observed_only` | Evidence exists but entrypoint not confirmed | Do NOT generate JSRPC action; output evidence for manual use |
| `unsupported` | Cannot access the function | Do NOT generate JSRPC action; output `unsupported_reason` |
